status: declared, unvalidated: statements by the international sources lane from source metadata; no cross-dataset comparison has been run
policy: Each dataset is a separate investigation with Family.OTHER. None enters NASA FLEX/ACME/BASS cohorts, splits or training; 'at_most' is the furthest use allowed before a dedicated qualification study.

JAXA-GCEM.phenomenon: flame spread and group-combustion excitation across fiber-supported fuel-droplet clouds; type 2 runs study movable droplets
JAXA-GCEM.fuel_reason: not stated in the DARTS documents inspected; the cited literature uses n-decane, unverified per run
JAXA-GCEM.geometry: droplets on a 30x30 SiC fiber lattice (14 um fibers) plus a single 78 um SiC fiber; 4 Fe-Cr wire igniters
JAXA-GCEM.platform: ISS Kibo JEM-PM, Chamber for Combustion Experiment / Group Combustion Experiment Module, 2017-02-16 to 2017-07-04
JAXA-GCEM.per_run_parameters_source: documents/gc_parameter.pdf: droplet size, droplet number, ignition-line droplet number, O2 concentration (17-21%), igniter (not yet parsed)
JAXA-GCEM.at_most: new expert candidate: JAXA group combustion
JAXA-GCEM.not: FLEX comparison of single-droplet D^2 histories (no droplet-diameter time series in telemetry; interacting droplet arrays)

ZARM-FLARE.phenomenon: opposed-flow flame spread over thin PMMA, continuous strips and strips interrupted by metal (Al / stainless steel) barriers
ZARM-FLARE.geometry: thin flat strips ('full samples') or fuel segments separated by 2-6 mm metal gaps ('gap samples')
measured_quantities: IR temperature field (x, y, t) [degC], distortion- and temperature-corrected
ZARM-FLARE.secondary: BASS validation only as an external sanity check of thin-PMMA opposed-flow spread rate trends, never pooled
